def execute_all_creation_final(ctx, actor, target, cfg):
    # LORE INTENT: Yuffie releases a large beam-like attack that strikes the enemy party.
    if not ctx.owns_ability(actor, ability_id): return NOT_OWNED
    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED
    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    ray = cast_ray_or_beam_volume(actor.cast_socket,aim,length,width)
    for hit in order_hits_by_distance(ray):
        if hit_should_stop_beam(hit): break
        resolve_typed_hit_once_or_at_defined_tick(hit.target)
    stop_beam_when_channel_finishes()
    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
    return SUCCESS
